summary: The demo/frontend service is experiencing high latency (p95 ~900ms). While the pod is running and passing readiness probes, it is consistently slow in responding to requests.

root_cause.explanation: The deployment was recently updated with a new argument '--ui-color=#2f6f4f' in the latest rollout, which may be introducing application-level processing overhead or resource contention.

evidence.fact: The latest deployment rollout (revision 30) added the flag '--ui-color=#2f6f4f' to the frontend container.
The service p95 latency is currently at approximately 899ms, exceeding the 500ms threshold.
The container's memory working set is ~28Mi, well within the 128Mi limit, suggesting memory exhaustion is not the immediate cause.

impact: End users of the frontend service are experiencing degraded performance with p95 latency nearly double the alert threshold of 500ms.

next_steps.action: Roll back the deployment to the previous revision (29) to verify if the latency issue is tied to the recent configuration change.
Examine detailed application logs for slow request processing times or backend communication errors.

unknowns: The specific impact of the '--ui-color' flag on application performance.
Potential performance issues with the upstream backend service at 'http://backend.demo.svc.cluster.local:9898/echo'.
